module.name: aws_eks_cluster_hp_nodes
module.description: Add a dedicated high-performance EKS managed node group for hosting TMM data-plane pods. Creates per-AZ TMM subnets (tagged f5-bnk-role=tmm-external for auto-discovery), a node IAM role with ENI-management permissions, a launch template with IMDSv2 + EBS encryption + secondary-ENI bootstrap user-data, and the node group itself with the app=f5-tmm label. Works for both blueprints (cluster-create greenfield and cluster-register brownfield).

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name + vpc_id + vpc_cidr + private_subnet_ids + availability_zones for an existing cluster.

optional.reason: Alternative upstream — emits the same output shape as cluster-register, so HP-nodes works identically for greenfield deploys.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time (any auth method).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time.

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the EKS cluster the HP node group attaches to.

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: Cluster VPC ID — where TMM subnets are created.

required.name: vpc_cidr
required.description: Cluster VPC primary CIDR, used for auto-carving TMM subnets when tmm_subnet_cidrs is empty.

required.name: availability_zones
required.description: AZs to spread HP nodes across. Should match the cluster's AZ spread.

required.name: node_subnet_ids
required.description: Cluster subnet IDs where the HP managed node group places its PRIMARY ENI (control-plane reach). The SECONDARY ENI lands in a TMM subnet via user-data.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

optional.name: tmm_subnet_cidrs
optional.description: Explicit TMM subnet CIDRs. Empty list = auto-carve from vpc_cidr.

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for HP nodes. Default supports SR-IOV + 100Gbps ENA.

optional.name: node_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired HP nodes per AZ. 0 = skip the node group entirely (subnets still created when tag_subnets_for_tmm = true).

optional.name: node_disk_size_gb
optional.description: Root volume size for HP nodes.

optional.name: secondary_eni_device_index
optional.description: Device index for the bootstrapped secondary ENI. 2 → ens7 on AL2023, matching the F5 reference NetworkAttachmentDefinition.

optional.name: additional_ips_per_eni
optional.description: Additional private IPs allocated on the secondary ENI at creation. 0 = let cneinstall's IPAM manage allocation.

optional.name: node_label_app
optional.description: Value for the 'app' label on HP nodes; FLO matches this to schedule TMM pods.

optional.name: tag_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: Tag TMM subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' so cneinstall auto-discovers them for the BNKGateway CR.

key_outputs.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
key_outputs.description: AZ → TMM external subnets, in cluster-register output shape. Override the cneinstall input of the same name when chaining HP-nodes ahead of cneinstall.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_group_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the HP managed node group. Empty when node_count_per_az = 0.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_group_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the HP managed node group.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN attached to HP nodes.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (STS / SSO / assumed-role only).
